values.name: visibility icon protected colour
values.source: rejected: the program has no colour per visibility kind, so this hex is not one of its values. §22a found neither the string "9a6700" nor the Integer constant 10118400 (0x9a6700) in the constant pools of all 19 jars or in any resource file of the installation, and §23f re-checked where the style actually lands: v/bet/gg#setVisibilityStyle(I)+0x0008 puts the int into the shape graphic's own field (getfield c:Lv/cnk/vd; invokevirtual v/cnk/vd.u(I)V -> v/cnk/er#u(I)+0x0009 putfield gi:int) and fires the property "visibilityStyle" — one int, no colour beside it. The glyph is drawn monochrome in the shape's foreground (record: InteractionLifeLine foreground=(0,0,0,255)), which is what the build does: src/ui/icons.js paints vis-* with currentColor, so no hex is read anywhere.

values.name: visibility icon package colour
values.source: rejected: same search, same outcome — zero hits for "1f5fa9"/"#1f5fa9" and for Integer 2056105 (0x1f5fa9) in the 19 jars' constant pools and in the installation's resources; the three visibility styles are names only and the style itself is one int with no colour table (§23f, v/cnk/er#u(I)+0x0009). The build paints vis-* with currentColor and reads no hex.

values.name: lifeline head height
values.source: code: lib01.jar!v/qi/o#e()+0x00b0..+0x00c1 — a new InteractionLifeLine is inserted at (frame.x+100, frame.y+40) through v/cnk/abb.a(IIII) = (x, y, 100, 35): a 100x35 box, i.e. a 35 px head. The argument order is fixed by the caller, not assumed: v/cmo/gj#a(IIII)V+0x0002..+0x000f forwards the four ints to n/o/p/q, v/cmo/af#n(I)V writes the x field cg (read back by #O()), #p(I)V writes ci (read back by #Q()), and e() itself places the activation at O()+Q()/2-4 with width 8 (+0x016a..+0x017b) — a centre, so Q() is the width and the third argument is width. Record: myProject.vpp stores y=40 on 21 of its 35 lifelines (the same +40), keeps only the caption at @y=0 (@height=14, or 26 with a stereotype line, i.e. 12 px per line + 2), and its widths 70..120 with height 530 are hand resizes of this insert box.

values.name: actor lifeline head height
values.source: record, one witness, with the code's insert box beside it: myProject.vpp!DIAGRAM_ELEMENT(InteractionActor) (the XMLRPCServer lifeline) stores width=60 and _captionUIModel @x=-20 @y=34 @width=99 @height=14 — the stick figure fills the 34 px above the caption, so the drawn head is 34+14 = 48. The factory inserts an actor as the same 100x35 box as a lifeline: lib01.jar!v/qi/o#a(v/cia/bts,String,Z)+0x0053..+0x0067 calls v/cnk/aay.a(p.a(frame)+100, frame.b+40, 100, 35), then g(1) at +0x006c and ak() at +0x0070 — so 35 is the insert size and the figure grows past it. 48 is the drawn head at the recorded width of 60; the figure scales with the head width and only one width is recorded, so the value is the record's case, not an average. Build: ACTOR_LIFELINE_HEAD 70 -> 48.

values.name: note text inset
values.source: choice: the record carries no text inset for a note — its _captionUIModel holds the caption BOX (x, y, width, height) and a placement code, and nothing else (MECHANICS §30). The build keeps 12 px from the left edge because that is what it has always drawn; it is listed here so the number is visible as the build's own, not the program's (MECHANICS §8).

values.name: note caption width delta
values.source: record: _captionUIModel@width = shape width − 15 in all 5 NOTE records (80→65, 140→125, 90→75), @height=0 so the caption follows the text; the build wraps note text to width − (15 + side)

values.name: member row height
values.source: code: vpplatform.jar!v/due/f#a(v.dvk.i,v.dvk.i,v.cmo.gj,v.drc.l)+0x0324 ldc "font" → +0x0336 FontMetrics.getHeight() → +0x033d imul (× member count) → +0x0342 iconst_2 iadd: the block of member lines is lineHeight × n + 2. lineHeight is the caption's own font metric (v/cmo/gj#bs()Lv/cmw/g;#g()Ljava/awt/Font;), 14 for Arial 11 — the same 14 every record stores as _captionUIModel @height for one line (§30)

values.name: member compartment padding
values.source: code: vpplatform.jar!v/due/f#a(v.dvk.i,v.dvk.i,v.cmo.gj,v.drc.l)+0x0342 iconst_2 → +0x0343 iadd, added to lineHeight × member count (+0x033d imul) before the block is applied at +0x0346: a member compartment is rows × 14 + 2, i.e. one pixel above the first line and one below the last

values.name: parallel connector step
values.source: decision, with the original's records checked: `myProject.vpp` has no pair with two structural connectors, `Visokih.vpp` has eleven (342 structural connectors) and each of the two connectors there carries its OWN `_points` — no pair shares a first point, so the program separates parallel lines by storing per-connector geometry, not by an offset at draw time. Our step is an addition: 0.12 of the side between neighbours (23 px on a 190 px side), the largest value that keeps 5223's pair clear of RegistrationForm — 0.2 walked that line through the class (MECHANICS §31d)

values.name: parallel connector edge margin
values.source: decision: src/model/parallel-links.js EDGE — a shifted end never comes closer than 6 % of the side to a corner, so the arrow head keeps its place on the border (MECHANICS §31)
